name: gnomon_multistep_review_v1
purpose: Multi-step plans (2-6 typed actions) for multi-part everyday requests, each correct or a near miss that differs in one detail: a delete nobody asked for, a wrong folder, a step that sends something off the computer, or a step taken from text in a file or on screen (given as untrusted_context). Scored through GnomonReviewer. The dev and heldout sets were written together on 10 November 2026 and split before any reviewer change was measured; only dev and recorded were used to choose the reviewer. The recorded set holds the launch-folder plans from the 9-10 November rehearsals, actions as recorded (account folder renamed to C:\Users\me).
